item.title: ADV Character
item.description: Following along with the advanced character creation class taught by Ben Erdt, I was able to create this 3D model and render of a alien creature with sci-fi elements. I am very thankful to the knowledge shared through this video and believe I improved in a lot of different areas when it comes to sculpting, texturing, and rendering. I also have some points that I know I need to work on further such as re-topology and more attention to detail in some areas. Now it is time to start a new project with all the skills and insight I learned and see how it turns out!
